items.title: 67848_Jimmy McPartland oral history interview
items.q: Plato's Government, that was a rough one.

ctx.x: A list of books that you should get and so forth and the different subjects and philosophy and so forth. Plato's Government, that was a rough one. And I had to get a big dictionary to find out what the words were. (LAUGHTER). And I did it religiously. I didn't smoke or drink. I didn't, quit smoking, quit drinking for two years.
Did you do the paper work involved or did you just sit in on the lectures?
